Initial Faction Design Notes

Shining Star Empire / Protectorate

The SSE and SSP use a Catholic-inspired ecclesiastical structure. Their anti-magic doctrine coexists with privileged clerical power and elite dispensations. Their armed forces combine disciplined conventional troops, support clergy, mechanical contrivances, and rediscovered war-golem technology.

Kergrin

Kergrin combines Nordic-inspired honor, kinship, craft, oathkeeping, martial readiness, and ancestral memory with dwarvish lore. The pre-Cataclysm illusion-concealed war-golem attack remains only a few Dwarven generations removed.

Yemthas

Yemthas is an insular Elven kingdom loosely inspired by North Korea. Foreign access is tightly controlled; outsiders are confined to approved routes and trade areas, while movement and information within the kingdom are managed through patrols, houses, and local administrative structures.

Castlemarch

Castlemarch draws on Byzantine Constantinople: a wealthy strategic choke point, layered bureaucracy, court politics, trade, and carefully managed criminal and intelligence networks.
